EmailTemplate.subject: [RESOURCES HUB] Planning with Confidence in the COVID-19 Era
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We hope this email finds you safe and healthy. In light of COVID-19, we realize that many worldwide are finding it difficult to leave their home for anything other than essential services.
To help you and your school plan with confidence <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/education/planning-with-confidence?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=planning%20with%20confidence%20hub%20page]]> for the upcoming academic year, we created a virtual resources hub that includes:
- New report on key policies, best practices, and flexible solutions for Fall 2020 Student Enrollment - Student communication toolkit to help your institution promote online payments
With many bank branches around the world either closing or reducing operating hours, online payment options are more important than ever, and we want to make sure you have the tools you need to help retain and drive enrollment.
<[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/education/planning-with-confidence?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=planning%20with%20confidence%20hub%20page]]>
If you have any questions, please reach out to your Relationship Manager or reply to this email.
